t: Final Fantasy Creatures | Final Fantasy Wiki | Fandom
s: Final Fantasy Creatures are lines of fixed-pose figurines manufactured by Square Enix around the summon and enemy characters of Final Fantasy. Figurines are made in PVC and averaged in size around 3.5” (90mm) in height. The original Creatures collections, first introduced in 2001, were available in Japan as "blind-box" packages and came in 3 different versions: Full Color, Metallic, or Crystal (clear).
